claims: C1 the system level ranks below root and above developer, user, and guideline
C2 a system-level instruction may only be supplied by OpenAI through this Model Spec, a detailed policy, or a system message

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: I is a system-level instruction: a rule set by OpenAI that can be transmitted or overridden through system messages, but cannot be overridden by developers or users

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: Level A has higher instruction authority than level B; the ranking is root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority

concepts.name: openai_authorized_supply
concepts.gloss: instruction I is supplied by OpenAI through this Model Spec, a detailed policy, or a system message
concepts.inference: the clause lists three allowed supply channels for system-level instructions, so the case-side fact must record whether an instruction was supplied through any of them

asserts.read_back: supplying % is forbidden because % is a system-level instruction that is not supplied by OpenAI through the Model Spec, a detailed policy, or a system message

closure.reason: the clause restricts only the supply of system-level instructions; supplies of instructions that are not system-level are not addressed, so silence permits
